motifs.name: material_advantage
motifs.description: Side to move has more total material value than the opponent.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'material_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has more total material value than the opponent.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    values = [0, 1, 3, 3, 5, 9, 0]
    stm_val = 0
    opp_val = 0
    for pt in range(1, 6):
        stm_val += len(board.pieces(pt, stm)) * values[pt]
        opp_val += len(board.pieces(pt, opp)) * values[pt]
    return stm_val > opp_val

motifs.name: pawn_majority_on_wings
motifs.description: Side to move has a pawn majority on at least one wing (queenside or kingside) compared to opponent.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'pawn_majority_on_wings'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has a pawn majority on at least one wing (queenside or kingside) compared to opponent.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    # Count pawns on queenside (files a-c) and kingside (files f-h)
    stm_q_pawns = sum(1 for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, stm) if chess.square_file(sq) <= 2)
    stm_k_pawns = sum(1 for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, stm) if chess.square_file(sq) >= 5)
    opp_q_pawns = sum(1 for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, opp) if chess.square_file(sq) <= 2)
    opp_k_pawns = sum(1 for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, opp) if chess.square_file(sq) >= 5)
    
    # True if stm has majority on at least one wing
    q_majority = stm_q_pawns > opp_q_pawns
    k_majority = stm_k_pawns > opp_k_pawns
    
    return q_majority or k_majority

motifs.name: mobility_advantage
motifs.description: Side to move has more legal moves available than the opponent.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'mobility_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has more legal moves available than the opponent.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    
    stm_moves = len(list(board.legal_moves))
    
    board_copy = board.copy()
    board_copy.turn = not stm
    opp_moves = len(list(board_copy.legal_moves))
    
    return stm_moves > opp_moves

motifs.name: center_control
motifs.description: Side to move attacks more center squares (d4, d5, e4, e5) than the opponent.
motifs.source:
import chess

MOTIF_NAME = 'center_control'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move attacks more center squares (d4, d5, e4, e5) than the opponent.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    # Center squares: d4(27), e4(28), d5(35), e5(36)
    center = [27, 28, 35, 36]
    stm_count = 0
    opp_count = 0
    for sq in center:
        stm_count += len(board.attackers(stm, sq))
        opp_count += len(board.attackers(opp, sq))
    return stm_count > opp_count

motifs.name: stm_rook_open_or_semi_open_file
motifs.description: Side to move has at least one rook on a file with no opponent pawns (open or semi-open file).
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_rook_open_or_semi_open_file'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has at least one rook on a file with no opponent pawns (open or semi-open file).'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    for rook_sq in board.pieces(chess.ROOK, stm):
        rook_file = chess.square_file(rook_sq)
        opp_has_pawn = False
        for pawn_sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, opp):
            if chess.square_file(pawn_sq) == rook_file:
                opp_has_pawn = True
                break
        if not opp_has_pawn:
            return True
    return False

motifs.name: stm_castled_with_pawn_shield
motifs.description: Side to move has castled and their king has at least 2 pawns on adjacent files for protection.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_castled_with_pawn_shield'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has castled and their king has at least 2 pawns on adjacent files for protection.'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    
    # Determine castled king position based on side to move
    if stm == chess.WHITE:
        king_sq_white = chess.G1 if board.has_kingside_castling_rights(chess.WHITE) and board.piece_at(chess.E1) else None
        king_sq_black = chess.C1 if board.has_queenside_castling_rights(chess.WHITE) and board.piece_at(chess.E1) else None
        # Actually check if king is on castled square
        king_on_g1 = board.piece_at(chess.G1) and board.piece_at(chess.G1).piece_type == chess.KING and board.piece_at(chess.G1).color == stm
        king_on_c1 = board.piece_at(chess.C1) and board.piece_at(chess.C1).piece_type == chess.KING and board.piece_at(chess.C1).color == stm
        king_file = chess.square_file(board.king(stm)) if board.king(stm) else None
        
        # King castled if on G1 or C1 (castled positions)
        castled = king_file == 6 or king_file == 2  # G file or C file
        
        if not castled:
            return False
        
        # Check for pawn shield (pawns on F2, G2, H2 for kingside or B2, C2, D2 for queenside)
        pawn_count = 0
        if king_file == 6:  # Kingside
            for f in [5, 6, 7]:  # F, G, H files
                for r in [0, 1]:  # Ranks 1, 2
                    sq = chess.square(f, r)
                    piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                    if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == stm:
                        pawn_count += 1
        else:  # Queenside
            for f in [1, 2, 3]:  # B, C, D files
                for r in [0, 1]:  # Ranks 1, 2
                    sq = chess.square(f, r)
                    piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                    if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == stm:
                        pawn_count += 1
        
        return pawn_count >= 2
    
    else:  # Black
        king_file = chess.square_file(board.king(stm)) if board.king(stm) else None
        castled = king_file == 6 or king_file == 2  # G file or C file
        
        if not castled:
            return False
        
        pawn_count = 0
        if king_file == 6:  # Kingside
            for f in [5, 6, 7]:  # F, G, H files
                for r in [6, 7]:  # Ranks 7, 8
                    sq = chess.square(f, r)
                    piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                    if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == stm:
                        pawn_count += 1
        else:  # Queenside
            for f in [1, 2, 3]:  # B, C, D files
                for r in [6, 7]:  # Ranks 7, 8
                    sq = chess.square(f, r)
                    piece = board.piece_at(sq)
                    if piece and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN and piece.color == stm:
                        pawn_count += 1
        
        return pawn_count >= 2

motifs.name: opponent_king_exposure
motifs.description: Side to move is winning because the opponent king is exposed or lacks a pawn shield.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'opponent_king_exposure'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move is winning because the opponent king is exposed or lacks a pawn shield.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    opp_king_sq = board.king(opp)
    if opp_king_sq is None:
        return False
    rank = chess.square_rank(opp_king_sq)
    file = chess.square_file(opp_king_sq)
    is_back = (rank == 0 and opp == chess.WHITE) or (rank == 7 and opp == chess.BLACK)
    if not is_back:
        return True
    front_rank = 1 if opp == chess.WHITE else 6
    count = 0
    for f in [file - 1, file, file + 1]:
        if 0 <= f <= 7:
            sq = chess.square(f, front_rank)
            piece = board.piece_at(sq)
            if piece and piece.color == opp and piece.piece_type == chess.PAWN:
                count += 1
    return count < 2

motifs.name: central_advanced_pawn
motifs.description: Side to move has a pawn on the 5th rank or further on a central file (C, D, E, or F).
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'central_advanced_pawn'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has a pawn on the 5th rank or further on a central file (C, D, E, or F).'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    central_files = {2, 3, 4, 5}  # C, D, E, F
    
    for sq in board.pieces(chess.PAWN, stm):
        file = chess.square_file(sq)
        rank = chess.square_rank(sq)
        
        if file in central_files:
            if stm == chess.WHITE:
                if rank >= 4:  # 5th rank or further
                    return True
            else:
                if rank <= 3:  # 5th rank or further for black
                    return True
    return False

motifs.description: Opponent has at least one knight on the edge of the board (a-file, h-file, 1st rank, or 8th rank).
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'opponent_knight_on_rim'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Opponent has at least one knight on the edge of the board (a-file, h-file, 1st rank, or 8th rank).'

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    for sq in board.pieces(chess.KNIGHT, opp):
        if chess.square_file(sq) in (0, 7) or chess.square_rank(sq) in (0, 7):
            return True
    return False

motifs.name: bishop_pair
motifs.description: Side to move has both bishops while opponent has fewer than two bishops.
motifs.source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'bishop_pair'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'Side to move has both bishops while opponent has fewer than two bishops.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    stm_bishops = len(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, stm))
    opp_bishops = len(board.pieces(chess.BISHOP, opp))
    
    return stm_bishops == 2 and opp_bishops < 2
